verdict.rationale: BVNK documents registrable outbound HTTP POST webhooks for account events such as pay-ins and payouts (bvnk-docs-40). Signatures can be verified with BVNK's webhook signature validator (bvnk-docs-21, bvnk-docs-30, bvnk-docs-42). Specific events are documented, including channel transaction confirmed on chain, late crypto transactions and wallet status changes. Missing for 10: an explicitly named conversion-executed/transfer webhook event, a specifically documented payout-settled event type, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
